# FTP and FTPS

<!-- BEGIN generated by .github/scripts/plugin_pages.py from the package's describe.json -->

FTP and FTPS servers: the `ftp` destination, from the `ftp` package. Declare the package once in `dependencies.yml`; DRE installs it on demand:

```yaml
# dependencies.yml
plugins:
  - ftp
```

### Profile fields

Set in `profiles.yml`, under `destinations:`, in a target with `type: ftp`.

| Field | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `host` (required) |  | FTP server. |
| `port` | `21` | Port. |
| `username` (required) |  | User name. |
| `password` |  | Password. Secret: use `env_var()`. |
| `tls` | `none` | None or explicit (FTPS) One of `none`, `explicit`. |
| `passive` |  | Passive mode (default true) |
| `tls_accept_invalid_certs` |  | Accept a self-signed server certificate. |
| `connect_timeout` | `30s` | How long to wait for a connection (`30s`, `2m`, or seconds) A duration (`30s`, `2m`) or seconds. |
| `timeout` | `60s` | How long a read or write may make no progress before it fails. A duration (`30s`, `2m`) or seconds. |
| `retries` | `3` | How many times to try again after a temporary error (0: never) |

### Options

Set in the report's `output.destination` entry.

| Option | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `if_exists` | string | `overwrite` | When a file is already at the path: `overwrite` it, fail with `error`, or `number` the new one. One of `overwrite`, `error`, `number`. |
| `atomic` | boolean | `true` | Upload under a temporary name, then rename, so no half-written file appears. |
| `temp_dir` | string |  | Where the temporary file goes (on the same server), for receivers that pick up any new file. |

<!-- END generated -->

## Notes

`host`, `port` (21), `username`, `password`, `passive` (default true), and `tls`: `none` or
`explicit` (FTPS). `tls_accept_invalid_certs` allows self-signed server certificates.

Paths are relative to the folder the login starts in; a leading `/` means the server's root,
which on many servers isn't the login folder (`/reports/x.csv` vs `reports/x.csv`). FTPS data
connections reuse the control connection's TLS session, which vsftpd, ProFTPD and FileZilla
Server require by default. Uploads go under a temporary name first (`atomic`, `temp_dir`: see
[Uploads under a temporary name](plugins.md#uploads-under-a-temporary-name)), and a failed upload removes the temporary file from the
server when it can. With `if_exists: error` or `number`, DRE looks for the name before the
rename; FTP can't do both in one step (see [A file already at the path](plugins.md#a-file-already-at-the-path)).

## Send an export over explicit FTPS

Use FTP when the receiver requires it; explicit FTPS protects the connection. Adapt the
report in the [SFTP delivery example](../examples/sftp-delivery/) with the `ftp` package and:

```yaml
# profiles.yml
destinations:
  partner:
    targets:
      dev: {deliver: false}
      prod:
        type: ftp
        host: ftp.example.com
        username: reporting
        password: "{{ env_var('DRE_SECRET_FTP_PASSWORD') }}"
        tls: explicit
        passive: true
```

```yaml
# within the report's output
destination:
  profile: partner
  path: "incoming/report-{{ run.date.yyyymmdd }}.csv"
  atomic: true
  temp_dir: staging
  if_exists: error
```

Keep `tls_accept_invalid_certs` disabled for a real server. A certificate failure needs the
server certificate or trust chain repaired. `ftp/file-exists` means the name is taken;
`delivery-failed` on rename needs write access in both directories and a supported rename.
For a firewall timeout, check passive data ports as well as the control port.
See [destination keys](reference-report.md#outputdestination),
[atomic uploads](plugins.md#uploads-under-a-temporary-name) and [destination](glossary.md#destination).
